name: glossary-browser
description: Browse a repository's ubiquitous language (GLOSSARY-MAP.md, each context's GLOSSARY.md, the ADRs) in a band above the prompt and a pane, and steer you and the model away from its Avoid words: a note to the model on prompts, a refusal on Markdown edits

denyEdits.title: Refuse Avoid words in edits
denyEdits.description: Refuse a Write or Edit to a Markdown file that uses an Avoid word of the context owning that file, so the model rewrites it with the canonical term. Sending the same edit again unchanged lets it through. Off, the Term Check only flags the word in the band.
